title: AddSpec
description: INPUT of `dmtool -m <model> rule add <spec.json>` / `dmtool -m <model> computation add <spec.json>` — the element to persist. Two shapes (chosen by the keys present): a RULE-spec (field/condition/code) or a COMPUTATION-spec (computedField/alternatives, detected by `computedField`). The element is validated against the real kernel before writing, and the persisted model is re-validated (so every declared message locale must be covered).

field.description: (rule) the error field's ABSOLUTE path, e.g. /Order/Quantity; its parent group becomes the rule group (iteration scope) UNLESS `group` overrides it. PLACEMENT LAW: a rule iterates over every repeatable group whose per-row fields it references, and the error field MUST lie inside each of those groups (else MVK_ERROR_FIELD_NOT_IN_RULEGROUP). So for a per-row rule ('each row must …') pick an error field INSIDE the repeatable group; for a whole-document rule aggregate the per-row operands (e.g. Sum(Group*/Field)) and use a non-repeatable error field. Tip: choose the error field at the lowest group that contains all referenced fields — relative paths stay short and survive a group move.

group.description: (rule) OPTIONAL rule group / iteration scope — an ABSOLUTE group path; defaults to the error field's parent. Override it for an operator whose rule must sit at the PARENT of a repeated group with the error field INSIDE it: `RepetitionNotUnique` needs `group:/Order` with `field:/Order/Items/Sku`. It is the same iteration scope `rule check` validates against (its group option), so a checked rule persists unchanged. The error field must lie inside the group.

condition.description: (rule) the condition in A12 DSL — TRUE on a VIOLATION/the error scenario (the rule fires when it holds), so to enforce a requirement write its violation, e.g. FieldNotFilled(X) not FieldFilled(X)

comment.description: (rule/computation) optional explanatory note, persisted as a leading ;; comment — on the rule's condition, or on a computation's first operation (the kernel tolerates it; it survives a later modify)

allowDifferingDecimals.description: (rule) the editor's 'Allow Differing Decimal Places' — prepend @SuppressWarning(MVK_INVALID_COMPARE_DEC_PLACES) so a field-vs-field == / != across differing decimal scales is accepted (the kernel's one suppressible warning). Default false.

annotation.description: (rule) OPTIONAL name→value annotations to set on the rule at add time (a rule has no label slot; change them later with `rule modify`). Read back via `rule read` under `annotations`.

internal-description.description: (rule) OPTIONAL per-locale (locale→text) internal description on the rule; read back via `rule read` under `internalDescription`.

external-description.description: (rule) OPTIONAL per-locale (locale→text) external description on the rule; read back via `rule read` under `externalDescription`.

computedField.description: (computation) the calculated field's ABSOLUTE path; the computation is placed in its parent group (its iteration scope). Same PLACEMENT LAW as a rule's error field: a computation that reads per-row fields must compute a field INSIDE that repeatable group; to compute a non-repeatable field from per-row data, aggregate first (e.g. Sum(Group*/Field)) — else MVK_ERROR_FIELD_NOT_IN_RULEGROUP.

commonPrecondition.description: (computation) optional guard (A12 DSL) shared by all alternatives

alternatives.description: (computation) ≥1 (precondition?, operation) tier — either one unconditional {operation} or all preconditioned {precondition, operation} (the kernel rejects mixing)

precondition.description: the tier's guard in A12 DSL (omit for the single unconditional alternative)

operation.description: the value-expression in A12 DSL, assigned to the computed field when the precondition holds

messages.description: ≥1 localized message; cover every locale the model declares

locale.description: a full locale code, e.g. en_US (bare 'en' is rejected by the kernel)

text.description: the message text; may interpolate kernel tokens, each using a model path: $<Field>.value$ (the field's runtime value), $<Field>$ (its localized label), $#<Group>$ (a repeatable group's 1-based row index) — e.g. "Row $#/Order/Items$: $/Order/Items/Qty$ ($/Order/Items/Qty.value$) is invalid". A LITERAL dollar sign is written $$ (so a price text reads "Amount must exceed $$100")

name.description: the element's name (rule: default = the code; computation: default = <Field>Comp)

examples.comment: cap the monthly fee per policy
effective fee equals the base fee
